title: KRDPASS Auth SDK Redirect URI Validation Test Vectors
description: Canonical redirect-response validation cases shared by KRDPASS Auth SDK integrations.

rule.summary: A response must use HTTPS and the configured redirect origin and encoded path. Query parameters registered on the redirect URI must be preserved exactly; single-valued authorization-response metadata is ignored.
details: Configured and incoming redirect URIs must use HTTPS, have a non-empty host, and contain neither userinfo nor a fragment.
The incoming URI must match the configured URI's normalized scheme, host, and effective port.
The incoming URI's encoded path must exactly match the configured URI's encoded path; host-only matching is not sufficient.
Every query parameter registered on the redirect URI must be present with the same value and multiplicity in the response URI.
Unconfigured authorization-response parameters may occur once and are ignored, as required by OAuth. Duplicate parameters and extra occurrences of configured query names are rejected.
Authorization-server registration remains the final authority for exact redirect URI matching. These client-side checks are defence in depth.

vectors.reason: The configured URI itself is a valid response target.
